verdict.rationale: Cekura is a testing and observability platform for voice agents, so a prompt playground is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence documents an interactive playground for iterating on prompts against real models and variables. A/B testing of agent versions, dynamic variables in evaluators, and creating test agents on Cekura are related features, but none of them is a prompt-iteration playground.

support.subject: As a developer, I can iterate on prompts in a playground against real models and variables
